title: Story premise ENT051: The Three-Lamp Switch Dance
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: Two presses. Three lamps. Which two? Takeaway/theme: Track the state changes rather than the switch names.
description: A toy technician must turn three dark lamps on. Left toggles lamps 1 and 2, middle toggles 2 and 3, and right toggles 1 only; after noisy guesswork, the technician presses middle then right, lighting all three in exactly two presses and revealing a tiny stage.
